text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Four Iranian sailors rescued in Gulf waters four days after their dhow sank receive treatment at a Bahraini hospital.
- Bahrain's Kanoo Group to set up a $6 million fund to support arts, literature and sports in Gulf Arab states.
- Payouts by Bahrain's General Organisation for Social Insurance nearly doubled last year to 2.1 million dinars, official says.
- Bahrain commercial banks' assets rose 22.7 million dinars in first quarter of 1997 to 3.38 billion dinars, Bahrain Monetary Agency says.
- Bahrain's public shareholding firms post 186.6 million dinars net profit in 1996, up 14 percent on a year earlier.
